newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Nov aluminium output up 0.4 pct on 1995.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Nov aluminium output up 0.4 pct on 1995.

text.p: Brazilian production of primary aluminium during November totalled 98,400 tonnes, the Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL) said in a statement.
This was 0.4 percent higher than output in November 1995 of 98,000 tonnes, it added.
Total output for the first eleven months of 1996 was 0.8 percent above that of January/November 1995, reaching just over 1.09 million tonnes as opposed to just under 1.09 million tonnes last year.
Total production this year ABAL estimates will reach 1.20 million tonnes, a rise of 0.9 percent on last year.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
